Permix

 

Permix is a lightweight, framework-agnostic, type-safe permissions management library for JavaScript applications on the client and server sides.

 AI agents

Your agents know every permission in place: the whole permission model lives in one typed createPermix schema, and any permission an agent invents, misspells, or forgets is a TypeScript error.

- Agent skills ship inside the npm package — npx skills add letstri/permix , or copy them from node modules/permix/skills/ so they match your installed version.
- LLM-friendly docs: llms.txt , llms-full.txt , and any docs page as Markdown by appending .md to its URL.

usage.title: Example
usage.html:
To quick start you only need to write the following code:

import { createPermix } from 'permix'

const permix = createPermix<{
  post: ['read']
}>()

permix.setup({
  post: {
    read: true,
  },
})

permix.check('post.read') // true

Permix has other powerful features, so here's check out the docs or the examples directory.
